# 🌌 MoodWorld

### Your Mood. Your World. Generated by AI.

MoodWorld is a Generative AI web application that transforms a user's selected mood and environmental preferences into a unique visual world.

The system combines emotion-based prompt generation with a pretrained Stable Diffusion model to create immersive AI-generated environments.

---

## 🎯 Project Overview

MoodWorld explores how emotions can be translated into visual characteristics such as:

- Colors
- Lighting
- Atmosphere
- Weather
- Environment
- Visual style

The user selects a mood and other environmental preferences. The system converts these selections into a detailed AI prompt and uses Stable Diffusion to generate a corresponding world image.

The application also generates a textual explanation of the created world and provides a browser-based text-to-speech feature.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🎭 Mood-based world generation
- 🌈 Emotion-driven color and lighting selection
- 🌲 Multiple environments
- 🌅 Different times of day
- 🌦️ Different weather conditions
- 🎨 Multiple visual styles
- ✍️ Custom user description
- 🤖 Stable Diffusion image generation
- 📝 AI-generated world description
- 🔊 Text-to-speech Listen feature
- ⏸️ Pause, Resume and Stop speech controls
- 🌐 Flask-based web interface

---

## 🧠 How It Works

The basic workflow of MoodWorld is:

User Input

↓

Mood + Environment + Time + Weather + Style + Custom Description

↓

Mood Engine

↓

Emotion → Visual Characteristics

↓

Prompt Generator

↓

Stable Diffusion

↓

AI Generated World Image

↓

World Description

↓

🔊 Listen
